title: 2006 Lebanon War
summary: Hezbollah crossed the frontier on 12 July 2006, killed and captured Israeli soldiers, and Israel answered with thirty-four days of air attack and a ground incursion into southern Lebanon. About twelve hundred Lebanese and a hundred and sixty Israelis were killed, much of the southern suburbs of Beirut and the country's infrastructure were destroyed, and a million people were displaced. It ended in a Security Council ceasefire with a strengthened peacekeeping force and no disarmament. Both sides claimed it; the party that had not lost against the strongest army in the region emerged from it as the dominant force in Lebanese politics.
